What if you tried the weirdest American foods in one day?

Some of these sound fake, but they're totally real. One, peanut butter and jelly sandwiches, which many countries find totally strange. Two, biscuits and gravy, soft bread covered in white sausage sauce. Three, root beer, a soda that lots of visitors say tastes like toothpaste.

But here's the twist. Four, ranch dressing, which Americans pour on pizza, wings and even fries. Five, corn dogs, hot dogs dipped in sweet cornbread batter and deep fried on a stick. And Americans eat around twenty billion hot dogs a year!
